text_block_list.text:
Air Groove got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, to think an injury of this degree
would cause me to fall behind...
choice_data_list: Once you're healed, let's make up for lost time!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, to think an injury of this degree
would cause me to fall behind...
choice_data_list: Once you're healed, let's make up for lost time!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I am the one who should reflect on this...
After all, I was the one doing the training."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will strive diligently to ensure
I never repeat such a blunder.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It is easy to say, but you cannot reclaim lost time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Falling behind here will haunt us
every step of the way from now on...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "We must accept that as fact and simply devote ourselves to working harder from now on."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Easy to say, but ordinary effort won't be enough to reclaim lost time, you know?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Are you saying that fully knowing what it means?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then make sure you are always prepared to give guidance.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As soon as this damn injury heals, I'm getting back to training right away!
